changes: Ordinary requests have an immutable cold-owned stop-token policy, optional extra IDs and explicit ignore-model-EOS behavior. IDs reject before model admission; configuration is separate from KV, graph, FamilyKey and sampler.

The original ledger owns a cold value copy. Ordinary completion commits the request stop fact, and observers consume it instead of recalculating fixed EOS. Full-prefix hits use the new request policy; pause/rebuild preserves the original policy and RNG.

Raw nondefault episodes cannot publish into an unbound/default ledger. The original abort actually retires before the same Session is retried with a valid cold binding. Finish never performs the first policy allocation.
Nondefault policies are rejected on MTP; existing default acceptance remains unchanged. No server/CLI policy flags, token-string matching, second owner/executor or hot configuration copy was added.

lifetime.request_relocation_source_contract: ledger owns its cold policy value; no request-address link. Actual request relocation after commits was not run.

failures.source_preparation: initial private generator anchor assertion and editor syntax typo were corrected before any build; no canonical/source behavior test failures

CTest_registration.scope: Existing lifecycle target, guarded by available CPU route, local-model/77 skip. Registration and full dispatcher are source-only; no configure/full target build in this batch.

ignore-model-EOS boolean semantics exercised in host; tiny V64 cannot emit Qwen original EOS248044/248046
